reason: tonedata has several maxima (De Veaux 1989). MoEClust stops below the maximum: 141.187 from its default hierarchical-clustering start, 132.070 from 20 random starts. mixtools' 20 random starts and mixture_regression() both reach 141.198 with the same estimates. On Linux under R 4.6.2 (equivalence CI, 2026-10-29) MoEClust reached the maximum, so the difference does not occur there.
